cd9fa24c7b8eb7b7c810.title: Signalpost — Online, 23 Aug – 21 Oct 2026
cd9fa24c7b8eb7b7c810.summary:
23 Aug – 21 Oct 2026  · Online Organiser: Builderr Signalpost is a challenge to build an agent that finds company information online, given a Norwegian company's organisation number, searching permitted public sources and showing where each fact came from.

Entrants must submit at least 1,000 completed company profiles chosen from the supplied list, along with their agent's repository link, exact commit hash, and one command to run it. The starting list covers 411,160 eligible Norwegian companies with 2025 annual-account records, and the agent must work from a company number, including ones it has not researched before.

Entries are scored out of 100 points across coverage, accuracy, correct updating, summary usefulness and ease of use, and must also meet minimum requirements including at least 65/100 overall and 21/35 coverage, plus 60% weighted recall and 95% precision on company matching.

The main challenge offers $2,000 in prizes split $1,200, $500 and $300 for first, second and third place, plus a separate $500 JBOX bonus split $250, $150 and $100 for qualifying agents built with JBOX.  Register on the organiser's own page

01d22a68766e35af4a48.title: Barcelona AI Hackathon — Barcelona, 9–10 Oct 2026
01d22a68766e35af4a48.summary:
9–10 Oct 2026  · Barcelona · In person · Itnig Coworking Organiser: Bogdan Ponomar Three tracks. €10,000 to the team that ships the best build.
Friday evening you get the theme. Saturday afternoon you demo. Everything in between is yours.

The challenge
Coding agents have changed what four people can build in a day. This is where we find out how much.
You get the theme at kickoff. You get thirteen hours of build time across two days. You ship something that runs in a mobile browser and that a stranger can pick up and use in 60 seconds.
Any stack. Any model, any agent, any tool you want.
No pitch decks. No business models. No slides. You hand someone a phone and they use it, or they don't.

Pick your track
Ship a game. Something playable in 60 seconds. Any genre, any mechanic.
Ship a tool. Productivity. Pick a task a real person does by hand every week and build the thing that does it for them.
Ship a habit. Something for health, fitness, sleep, food — anything that makes a person do the right thing tomorrow.
Choose your track when you apply, or decide on the Friday once you've seen the theme. Each track gets its own winner.

€10,000
To the winning team. Cash.

How it's judged
Saturday afternoon, every build goes live and everyone in the room tries everything.
The €10,000 is decided by the jury — the Lytvyn.AI.Foundation , our mentors, and the organising team. Four things they're looking for:
Is it good. Is it actually finished. Is it original. And how hard did you push your agents to get there.
Every team publishes their setup afterwards: models, tools, prompting approach, total tokens burned. By Saturday night we'll know exactly what fifteen teams shipped in thirteen hours and what it cost them.

Schedule
Friday 9 October 
18:00 — Doors, food, check-in 
18:30 — Kickoff. Clock starts. 
23:00 — Venue closes. Go home, sleep on it.
Saturday 10 October 
08:00 — Doors, breakfast, back to work 
16:00 — Code freeze 
16:15 — Demos. Everyone tries everything. 
17:45 — Winners announced 
18:15 — Afterparty

Mentors on the floor, food and coffee throughout

Teams
Up to 4 people. Bring your own team, or come solo and we'll match you on the Friday.

Who this is for
Working engineers, technical founders, and anyone already building seriously with coding agents.
You don't need to have built anything like this before — most people here won't have. You need to be able to ship.

Bring
Your own laptop. Your own AI subscriptions and API keys — Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, whatever you already run on. Come with your setup working and your environment ready, so the clock goes on building instead of installing.

Included
Free entry. Food and drinks across both days. Mentors. Afterparty. A room full of people who ship.

70 places
That's the whole room, and we're keeping it that way on purpose.
Applications are reviewed — this is not a ticket. Apply below and we'll come back to you within a few days.

Venue announced shortly — central Barcelona. Powered by the Lytvyn.AI.Foundation.  Register on the organiser's own page

15 Oct 2026  · London · In person · London, United Kingdom Organiser: Briefcase AI Agents in Fintech - Evening Hackathon
150 developers. One evening. Central London.
Build autonomous AI agents that handle real financial operations - agents that don't just analyse money, but move it. Ship a working prototype in three hours and demo it live to judges from Stripe, Meta, and the 10 Downing Street AI Team.
📅 Schedule
5:15 PM - Doors open & registration
5:45 PM - Opening: mission briefing, tracks and scoring explained
6:00 PM - Hacking begins. Go solo or team up (max 4 per team)
7:30 PM - 🍕 Pizza - keep building
9:00 PM - Code freeze. Submit via the event page
9:05 PM - Judging & finalist selection
9:30 PM - Finalist demos
9:50 PM - Awards

🚀 Why Join?
Ship something real - walk out with a working fintech AI agent you built in one evening
Win £2,000 - cash prize for the overall winner
Stripe credits - £5k, £3k, and £1k in credits for track winners
Side quests - bonus prizes for creative builds beyond the main tracks
Meet your next co-founder - 150 of London's sharpest AI and fintech builders in one room
🎯 Tracks
Two tracks, revealed at the opening briefing. One hint: your agent will be handling real money movement - think autonomy, policy, and auditability. Plus bonus side quests for builds that go off-script.
🧑‍💻 Who Should Come?
Developers, ML engineers, and technical founders who want to build with AI agents in fintech. Come with a team of up to 4, or join solo and pair up on the night.

044a3b3d18e55bbfb73c.title: Real-Time Video Agents Hack - LDN — London, 17 Oct 2026
044a3b3d18e55bbfb73c.summary:
17 Oct 2026  · London · In person · London, United Kingdom Organiser: tokens& The VAST Builders Challenge is a three-city technical event series bringing together founders and engineers across New York, London, and San Francisco to build production-ready AI systems.
Spend the day building agents to unlock the value of video. Because video is hard to search and analyze,  most of it stays in storage, unwatched and underused.
Experiment with the latest AI infrastructure, collaborate with other ambitious builders, and turn your ideas into shippable prototypes - with access to expert guidance, compute, and the tools you need to ship.
Hosted with VAST Data in collaboration with NVIDIA, SpaceXAI, CoreWeave and Weights & Biases.
Note: Registration closes on 9th October.
Prizes
1st place: NVIDIA DGX Spark™
HuggingFace Microduck
Cursor Credits
Cash Gift Cards

The Builders Stack
Here's what you get out of the box, a lightning-quick setup:
Video understanding: reason over a video clip with NVIDIA Cosmos.
Semantic search: find moments across hours of footage using natural language.
Object detection: real-time detection and tracking across frames with YOLO.
General-purpose LLMs: models from Weights & Biases to power your application logic (e.g. video agents).
The VAST AI OS orchestrates the video ingestion and data layer, models are served on CoreWeave GPUs, and builders ship with Cursor.
Build your own video agent or something no one’s thought of. We'll share the videos to get you started on building video agents.

Speaker
Brian Verkley - Director, AI Data Platform @ VAST Data
Judges
Abubakr Karali -  Senior Solutions Architect @ Nvidia
Ram B. -  Sr. Developer Advocate @ VAST Data
Brian Verkley - Director, AI Data Platform @ VAST Data
Junaid Butt -  AI Solutions Engineer @ Weights and Biases

Who should attend
Developers, ML/AI engineers, agent builders, and data engineers, from startups to enterprise teams working with video or multimodal AI.
While individuals are welcome, we encourage teams of up to four members and will prioritize team applications. You can form a team on the day of the event or arrive with one already assembled.
Applications are required. Space is limited. Registration closes one week prior to the event.
*Register with Personal Email*
We'll use this for event comms and to credit your Cursor account. Sign up for Cursor with this same personal email if you don't have an account.

Agenda
8:30am Doors Open + Breakfast 
9:00am Opening Keynotes
9:30am Build Begins
12:30pm Lunch
4:30pm  Demos
6:30pm Closing & Awards
Note: This event will be photographed and filmed. By attending, you consent to appearing in photos and videos that may be used for social media and promotional materials.

Sponsors
VAST Data: A unified AI data platform that provides the foundation for managing, processing, and activating data for AI workloads
CoreWeave: AI cloud infrastructure that delivers high-performance GPU compute for training, fine-tuning, and inference workloads.
SpaceXAI: AI-assisted software development tools that help developers move from idea to implementation faster
NVIDIA: Accelerated computing and AI software that enables developers to build and deploy advanced AI applications
Weights & Biases (A CoreWeave company): AI developer tools for experiment tracking, model evaluation, and collaborative ML development

See what’s possible.

Follow us on X · LinkedIn · Newsletter  Register on the organiser's own page

b396b35bff130b491836.title: Agentic Hackathon: From Research to Commerce — Berlin, 19 Oct 2026
b396b35bff130b491836.summary:
19 Oct 2026  · Berlin · In person · The Delta Campus Organiser: AI Agents Berlin From Research to Action: Agents That Discover, Verify & Transact

Seven hours to build an agent that actually does something. Form a team, pick a track, ship a working demo by the evening — then carry the best builds through to AIB Demo Day in December.

Monday 19 October, 14:00–21:00, at The Delta Campus, Berlin. Food and drinks throughout.

Tracks

- Research Agents: Build agents that search, retrieve, evaluate, summarise and reason over information. A fit for web research, source discovery, market intelligence, due diligence, monitoring, knowledge workflows and verified research pipelines.
- Agentic Commerce: Build agents that discover products or services, compare options, verify information and support transactions or commercial workflows. A fit for product discovery, shopping agents, marketplace automation, price comparison, procurement, MCP-based commerce workflows and agentic payments.

Agenda

- 14:00 — Doors, check-in, food
- 14:30 — Welcome, tracks and rules
- 14:45 — Partner challenges, five minutes each
- 15:10 — Team formation, solo builders paired up
- 15:45 — Build
- 18:15 — Working dinner, building continues
- 20:00 — Demos, three minutes per team
- 20:45 — Winners and what happens next
- 21:00 — Close

Partners

- Tavily — a search and retrieval API designed for powering intelligent agents with real-time, verifiable web data
- Nebius — a high-performance AI cloud platform for building and scaling modern AI systems
- Affinidi – giving every AI agent a verifiable identity
- n8n — workflow automation for agentic systems

Partner challenges, prizes and technical resources are announced on the day.

What you get

- Compute and API credits from our partners, and n8n Cloud Pro licences for participating builders.
- Mentors from the partner teams in the room while you build.
- A jury of partners and investors watching the demos.

A route to Demo Day on Dec 10: standout builders win an AIB Builder Pass, and with it a demo slot in front of the season's partner and investor bench.

Who should join

This hackathon is for:

- AI engineers and full-stack developers
- Agent builders
- Founders and product teams
- Data, search and retrieval engineers
- AI x commerce builders
- Students and researchers working on applied AI agents.

You can join solo or with a team. Builders will have the day to form teams, build, and demo their projects.

Team rules

You can join solo or with a team.

- Max. 5 people per team
- At least one team member must be onsite in Berlin
- Solo builders are welcome — we will support team formation at the beginning
- Please bring your laptop and anything else you need to build
- The event is builder-focused: please only register if you plan to actively build, mentor, judge, or support teams

Want to mentor, judge or speak?

Tell us here and we will get back to you.

Interested in sponsoring the hackathon?

Partner packages and everything else commercial start here.

About AI Agents Berlin

Berlin's community for the agentic economy. Builder sessions, hackathons, and the Agentic Economy Forum. 11,000+ community contacts and 2,000+ agent builders.

Join the builder community on Telegram to share what you are building and connect with other agent builders. More on the 2026 season on our website.  Register on the organiser's own page

Join us and 200+ hackers from all across Europe and beyond for the European Defense Tech Hackathon on November 6-8, 2026, in Lisbon, Portugal.

190a10e750be7cba5cf9.summary:
14–15 Nov 2026  · Paris · In person · Paris Organiser: Panossian NASA Space Apps Challenge - Paris 2026
Ou l'innovation humaine rencontre l'exploration spatiale.
Lien : https://www.spaceappschallenge.org/2026/local-events/paris/
Le NASA Space Apps Challenge est le plus grand hackathon mondial annuel, organisé par la National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA). Organisé dans plus de 160 villes à travers le monde, cet évènement rassemble des milliers d'innovateurs, développeurs, scientifiques, designers et créatifs afin de concevoir des solutions concrètes pour la Terre et l'espace à partir des données ouvertes (Open Data) de la NASA et de ses agences spatiales partenaires.
Dates : 14-15 Novembre 2026
Format : Présentiel uniquement (In-person only)
Lieu : Paris / Grand Paris - Le lieu exact (venue) sera communiqué dans les plus brefs délais.
Langues : Français & Anglais
Prix : Gratuit & ouvert à tous
Profils recherchés
Que vous soyez etudiant, developpeur, ingenieur, designer, scientifique, artiste ou simplement passionne par l'espace et le climat, c'est l'occasion de contribuer a des solutions a fort impact qui pourront etre analysees par les scientifiques de la NASA.
Il n'est pas necessaire d'etre un expert en astrophysique ou en programmation. Les equipes beneficient de la diversite de leurs membres :
Etudiants & Chercheurs (Informatique, Data, Physique, Design, Business)
Developpeurs & Data Scientists
Designers, Artistes & Storytellers
Passionnes d'espace et d'innovation
Axes de travail & Thématiques
Les défis (Challenges) sont préparés par les experts de la NASA et des agences spatiales partenaires (ESA, CNES, etc.) autour de grands axes :
Earth & Climate : Observation de la Terre, changement climatique, agriculture durable et biodiversité.
Space Exploration : Exploration lunaire et martienne, astrophysique, exoplanètes et débris spatiaux.
Software & AI : Traitement de données spatiales, intelligence artificielle et outils interactifs.
Storytelling & Design : Visualisation de données, outils pédagogiques et sensibilisation du public.
Contact & Partenariats
Pour toute question, mentorat ou opportunite de partenariat (sponsoring, mise a disposition de materiel), veuillez contacter :
yassinehadi25@gmail.com

e1e52cc946a0772fd118.title: European Defense Tech Hackathon – Paris — Vincennes, 20–22 Nov 2026
e1e52cc946a0772fd118.summary:
20–22 Nov 2026  · Vincennes · In person · Vincennes, France Organiser: European Defense Tech Hub The event will run through our EDTH event platform. Registration on Luma is not required. Please register directly on the platform to get your ticket, and you'll also find the agenda, challenges, and team formation there: https://events.eurodefense.tech/2026-paris

----

Time to Accelerate European Defense Innovation 🚀

Join us and 200+ hackers from all across Europe and beyond for the European Defense Tech Hackathon on November 20-22, 2026, in Paris, France.

We'll focus on solving urgent security challenges:
 🛸 Stopping Shahed-class and fiber-optic drones
 🎯 Tracking targets across messy sensor setups
 📡 Keeping systems working when everything is jammed

We're thrilled to co-organize this hackathon with the team behind the Adopt AI Summit (Dec 3-4, 2026, at Grand Palais)—matching AI expertise with real-world deployment needs in the defense sector.

Wanna come as a visitor? Join our EDTH Community here: https://community.eurodefense.tech/

Goal

We want to bridge the gaps between technologists, the public sector, investors, and operators in dual-use and defense technology. This hackathon will demonstrate the talent and drive of the European ecosystem.

Get inspired by the challenges we have prepared, or feel free to bring your own project. You'll get feedback from folks who have been on the frontline to ensure you're solving real problems.

Our goal with the hackathon is to put you in a position to continue towards deployment.

Who joins the hackathon?

Hackers

Hackers are the people actually building. They form small teams, pick a problem, and spend the weekend turning ideas into working prototypes. It starts on Friday with team formation, gets intense on Saturday, and ends on Sunday with our Demo Day where they show what they’ve built.

Mentors

Mentors are the ones helping the hackers with all the relevant expertise to build a defense tech project. They share real-world context and help teams avoid dead ends, whether it’s sharpening the problem, pressure-testing assumptions, or making something actually deployable.

Visitors

To give participants time and space to focus on their projects, there will be no visitors during the hacking phase (until Sunday 12 pm).

If you’re curious about the outcomes and what the teams have built, you can join the Demo Day on Sunday (from 1 pm) as an EDTH Community visitor by selecting a Community Visitor ticket.

Not yet part of the EDTH Community?

Get free access to all EDTH Community events for one year, including hackathon demo days, webinars, networking sessions, and our flagship New Defense Summit

Sign up to become a member here: https://community.eurodefense.tech/

Challenges

We'll focus on solving urgent security challenges: stopping Shahed-class and fiber-optic drones, tracking targets across messy sensor setups, and keeping systems working when everything is jammed.

Think low-cost sensing, AI that can tell what’s coming and where it’s going, and interceptor logic that goes from detection to action.

Comms that don’t rely on infrastructure, making sense of data from everywhere—RF, cameras, thermal, you name it—and autonomy that actually reduces operator load.  Register on the organiser's own page

3a937054329e79f0fd48.title: Creative AI Hackathon — Amsterdam, 20 Feb 2027
3a937054329e79f0fd48.summary:
20 Feb 2027  · Amsterdam · In person · AI AM Organiser: TAG Everyone is talking about AI in the creative industry. But how far can you really take it in a single day?
On Saturday 3 oktober, we're bringing together creatives from videography, animation, music, design, 3D, short films, and advertising for a full day of building with AI. The challenge: push the work to the highest level currently possible.
At AI.AM in the Hub in Amsterdam-Oost, the AI epicenter of the Netherlands 👇
🎯 What does the day look like? Everyone works within their own discipline on their own piece of work. Around 17:00, each participant presents what they've made and explains the choices behind it: what worked, what didn't, and where the AI ended and the maker began. A jury evaluates the work.
👥 Who is it for? For any creative maker who works with AI or wants to learn how. Whether you already build with these tools daily or are just starting to experiment, you're welcome.
🏆 Prizes
1 month of free office space at TAG
10 days in an edit suite
Prize money + credits
📍 Practical info Saturday 3 oktober 2026, 09:30 to 19:00 TAG, INIT building, Jacob Bontiusplaats 9, Amsterdam
-----------

TAG Creative Hackathon

Iedereen heeft het over AI in de creatieve sector. Maar hoe ver kun je er écht mee komen in één dag?
Op zaterdag 3oktober brengen we creatieven uit videografie, animatie, muziek, design, 3D, short films en reclame een dag lang bij elkaar om met AI te bouwen. De uitdaging: het werk naar het hoogste niveau tillen dat op dit moment mogelijk is.
In de Hub bij AI.AM in Amsterdam-Oost, het AI-epicentrum van Nederland 👇

🎯 Hoe ziet de dag eruit?
Iedereen werkt in zijn eigen discipline aan een eigen stuk werk. Rond 17:00 presenteert iedereen wat hij heeft gemaakt, en licht toe welke keuzes zijn gemaakt: wat werkte, wat niet, en waar de AI eindigde en de maker begon. Een jury beoordeelt het werk.

👥 Voor wie?
Voor iedere creatieve maker die met AI werkt of ermee wil leren werken. Of je nu al dagelijks met deze tools bouwt of net begint te experimenteren: je bent welkom.

🏆 Te winnen
1 maand gratis kantoorruimte bij TAG
10 dagen in een edit suite
prijzengeld + credits

📍 Praktisch
Zaterdag 16 mei 2026, 09:30 tot 19:00 TAG, bij AI.AM in de Hub, jacob bontiusplaats 9, Amsterdam  Register on the organiser's own page

e24b0a05a8c19350b63e.title: Build Agents That Remember Hackathon @42Paris — Paris, 16–18 Oct 2026
e24b0a05a8c19350b63e.summary:
16–18 Oct 2026  · Paris · In person · 42 Paris Organiser: 42 Entrepreneurs Prize pool: $3,000 Build Agents That Remember

Every day, we give AI agents more tools, more autonomy, and more things to do.Then we close the window, and they forget almost everything.

screenpipe (YC26) changes that. It turns your computer history into memory for any AI: search anything you’ve seen or heard, turn meetings and daily work into summaries, follow-ups and automations. Everything stays local by default, and agents plug in through a local API and MCP server.

The premise is simple: give an agent a memory, then see what becomes possible.

From October 16–18 at École 42 Paris, 42Entrepreneurs and screenpipe are bringing together developers, builders and AI enthusiasts for 48 hours to build something useful, strange, ambitious or something we haven’t thought of yet.

The challenge

Build across three tracks:

Find what to automate Use screenpipe history to find repetitive tasks. Build an interface that helps someone understand the steps and decide what to automate.

Teach an agent your workflow Turn recorded work into an automation using agent skills, tools or model training. Show it completing a real task from start to finish.

Make it work for a team Turn a personal workflow into an automation others can use, with the setup, approvals and shared tools they need.

Prizes & opportunities

$3,000 in prizes + a paid contract with screenpipe.

The winning project will have the opportunity to work directly with screenpipe to integrate the hack into the product, plus a meal with the founders.

And the opportunity doesn’t necessarily end with the hackathon.

screenpipe (YC26), based in San Francisco, is also looking for 1–2 interns or apprentices for 4–6 months among the builders they meet during the weekend.

Teams

Come with a team or come alone.

Teams are made up of 3–5 people.

We’ll help participants meet and form teams during the opening, with a dedicated Discord channel available before the hackathon to find teammates and exchange ideas.

You don’t need a finished idea before coming.

What to expect

48 hours of building at École 42 Paris, with technical resources from screenpipe, support throughout the weekend, food and drinks, final demos and a jury.

Bring your laptop. We’ll take care of the rest.

Who can join?

The hackathon is open to 42 students and external builders.

Whether you’re already building agents every day or just want to experiment with persistent AI context, you’re welcome.

See you at 42.  Register on the organiser's own page

fe5110be7490eab6d9ac.summary:
22 Oct 2026  · Paris · In person · Metafore Boétie - St Augustin Organiser: Iterate The rules of company building are being rewritten in real time.

The next generation of founders is right here in Europe and they're thinking globally from the start.

With AI shortening the path from idea to product, founders can now move faster than ever before, but what does the future hold and who will be building it?

AI Innovate is where Future Founders can come together, share ideas, build and meet the people worth building with across five cities. Paris is our fourth stop and we can't wait to see the ideas of Future Founders come to life.

Join the hackathon, imagine what comes next and build it. In one day!

- 08:00: Registration and breakfast
- 09:00: Kickoff and hacking

December 3–6, 2026 · Helsinki → Lapland

200 hackers start with one day of building in Helsinki. By the end of that day, 40 are selected to board a train to Lapland and keep building over the weekend.

The route

- Dec 3 · Otaniemi - Ground Hack: Build on partner challenges.
- Dec 4 · Train to Lapland: The selected 40 keep building on the way north, then pitch that evening at Kaamos Lodge.
- Dec 5 · Lapland: Office hours, 1:1s, sauna and final dinner.
- Dec 6 · Return: Back to Helsinki.

What’s on the line

A trip to Lapland · Cash prizes for the top 3 teams · Partner challenge prizes · €15,000+ in tools and credits

If you make the cut

Hotel, train, lodge and meals are covered. You only need to get yourself to Helsinki.

Before you apply

- Teams of 3-4
- Keep Dec 4-6 open in case you’re selected
- Challenges and speakers announced soon

Free to apply. We review every application and confirm whether you’re in.
